scope: Profile frozen P07, then evaluate P02 PK equality SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE using existing lookup
hypothesis: A PK equality currently scans the full visible table; lookup can bound row visits while preserving all validation, predicates and statement staging
stop_conditions: Material default workload regression without explanation

candidate.profile_observation: P07 point workload: 9087500 load calls / 9077500 matches / 911 DiskMap scans; P02: 10455 / 455 / 1. The remaining 10000 loads and one scan build the vector index.
candidate.reason: Two complete three-round point workloads show repeatable SELECT gain (3.1823x/3.7442x) and smaller update/delete gains. Default vector workload E is 0.494849 and 0.531551 across opposite-order seeds, so repeatable contest-workload aggregate improvement is not established. Preserve P07 as best; retain candidate branch/image/build and all raw evidence.
candidate.learning_summary: B03先profile当前P07再评估P02。P07的1万行点负载有9087500次行加载、9077500次谓词判断；P02复用事务可见的lookup，并保留全部提前校验、AND条件及语句暂存，调用分别降至10455/455。P07控制组与候选原生/Docker/sanitizer均通过1218次点查询、812次扫描对照、90个错误反例及120次随机操作；公开20例、扩展、故障恢复和119次独立查询对照通过。小表筛选未显示稳定端到端收益，更新项更慢，结果保留；完整两种子点查询中位数约快3.18/3.74倍，更新/删除改善较小，插入基本持平。默认向量完整三轮本地E为0.494849/0.531551，综合收益不重复，故P02仅保留独立分支，不替换P07最佳。128MiB/256MiB活跃数据通过且无换页；没有把P07旧的2GiB测试标成P02新通过。以上实现、解释和实验归Agent/工具，不证明学生已掌握相关知识，也不推算官方成绩。
known_limits: Point workload is not official performance scoring workload
No repeatable default E benefit established; time/order/seed variability not causally isolated
-pg timings are diagnostic and not platform T/B/M
P02 full 2GiB/2304MiB test not rerun because no memory structure/log format changes; 128MiB/256MiB passed
Official 29 cases, reference performance and Agent evaluation not run
